citations.claim: body just inside arena before violation
first violating step exceeds arena by 0.389
speed remains ~39 throughout, showing continuous high-velocity motion

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from 38.887 to 15.0 (single field change); lower displacement per step prevents arena overshoot within 22 steps

explanation: Shrunk scenario has one body with very high horizontal speed (vx~38.9, dt~0.0157, displacement ~0.61 per step) and no walls. Substepping (21 substeps) is insufficient to enforce arena clipping. At step 21 body is just inside arena (x=18.95, overshoot -0.22) and at step 22 it has moved to x=19.57 with radius 0.823, overshoot +0.389 >0.15, triggering in_arena. Reducing initial speed to 15 (one-field change) keeps body inside bounds for same 22 steps, confirming high velocity / insufficient boundary enforcement is causal.
vision_note: The red body moves steadily rightward across steps 19-21 and in step 22 visibly penetrates and protrudes beyond the right arena boundary wall. This shows a failure to contain the fast-moving body inside the arena despite arena wall enforcement.
